create_NameScope: create a NameScope instance to manage identifier scoping for an MJCF model with a given name
add_identifier_to_namespace: add a new identifier to a specific namespace in the NameScope to register an MJCF object
remove_identifier_from_namespace: remove an identifier from a namespace in the NameScope to unregister an MJCF object
get_full_prefix: get the hierarchical prefix string for identifiers in a NameScope by traversing parent scopes
rename_identifier_in_namespace: rename an identifier within a namespace in the NameScope by adding the new name and removing the old
